# Secret-shaped test inputs, stored in parts so no line looks like a real credential.
# The test joins the parts: `pem*` rows are one text ("\n" is a newline); the others are
# `TYPE|leading text|part|part...`, the expected span being the parts joined.
case01|API_KEY|key=|sk-proj-|AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt_12
case02|API_KEY||AIza|SyA1234567890abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv
case03|API_KEY||xoxb-|1234567890-abcdefghij
case04|API_KEY||sk_live_|abcdefghijklmnop1234
case05|API_KEY||SG.|abcdefghijklmnop1234|.abcdefghijklmnop1234
case06|API_KEY||glpat-|abcdefghij1234567890
case07|JWT|Bearer |eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9|.|eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIn0|.|abcdefghij-_KLMN
pem1|k:\n|-----BEGIN |RSA |PRIVATE KEY-----|\nMIIEow\nIBAAKC\n|-----END |RSA |PRIVATE KEY-----|\nafter
pem_end|-----END |RSA |PRIVATE KEY-----
pem_cut|-----BEGIN |PRIVATE KEY-----|\nMIIEvQIBADANBgkq\nhkiG9w0BAQEFAASC\n\nnot base64 here
